name: @alphabeta/analysis
description: Framework-free stats core shared by the /lab tools and in-bet instrument panels.

scripts.sync:landing: npm run build && mkdir -p ../../apps/landing/lab/analysis && cp dist/special.js ../../apps/landing/lab/analysis/special.js && cp dist/power.js ../../apps/landing/lab/sample-size/analysis.js && cp dist/srm.js ../../apps/landing/lab/srm/analysis.js && sed "s|'./special.js'|'../analysis/special.js'|" dist/results.js > ../../apps/landing/lab/results/analysis.js && sed "s|'./special.js'|'../analysis/special.js'|" dist/bayes.js > ../../apps/landing/lab/bayes/analysis.js && cp dist/sequential/index.js ../../apps/landing/lab/sequential/analysis.js
